summary: A one-minute walkthrough of the Commitments tab in the Seller Performance dashboard. The narration speaks to the seller as "you". A commitment means the seller agrees to supply a quantity of a device at a fixed price for the whole window. The screen shows this round's window as 20 Oct 2026 → 10 Nov 2026, with submissions closing Thu 22 Oct, 18:00 (UAE time). The page has two tables: UAE & South Africa, and Saudi Arabia. Only the UAE & South Africa table appears on screen. For each device, Revibe suggests a price and a quantity. The seller types the price and quantity they can commit to, or clicks "Use suggested", and leaves the devices they don't want empty. Splitting the quantity by colour (one SKU per colour) is optional. If the seller does split, the colours must add up to the quantity; otherwise the line is flagged "1 line to fix" and drops out of the offer totals. The seller then clicks "Save my offer". Offers can be changed until the deadline, and every saved version is kept; the "Saved versions" list shows the date and time, totals and who saved it. After the close, Revibe reviews the offers and confirms the accepted ones. Accepted commitments are locked in the buybox at the seller's price for the whole window until the quantity is sold, so the seller can buy stock in advance with confidence. Prices are in AED. The narration is clear: the only low-confidence words ("{seller?}" and "6 {p?}.m.") are confirmed by the screen. The account shown is a demo ("Demo Seller", you@your-company.com).
